A.randomized: input range of A*: Gaussian width ceil(c/pi)+32, oversampling implicit, one subspace iteration with intervening QR; small projected SVD; double width on failed independent 12-probe check
A.memory: sampled RSS every 5 ms during preparation and OS HWM before dense audit; full target kernel prohibited in builders; tiles 64 rows
A.audit: full discrete spectral residual after preparation; 12 independent Gaussian operational probes charged equally to all arms; neither probe test nor spectral mu tail is a continuous error certificate
A.reuse: eight RHS and bounded output multiplier; same prepared factor API for all arms
A.confirmation: after pilot, freeze case IDs and run fresh-process paired repeats; no hot calls counted as samples

B.metric: physical source L2(r dr) and output L2(y dy), same unweighted norm for every backend; combined sqrt(source_relative_error^2+transform_relative_error^2)
B.claim: basis-specific profile alone cannot establish advantage; report every profile and reference convergence

C.scope: Sonine positive order increment, finite support dilation, then only if stable a compressed connection; preserve failed gates

D.optimizer: scipy least_squares TRF, analytic Jacobian, identical bounds and tolerances, normalized residual, amplitude prior 1e-8, max_nfev 60
D.heldout: every fourth flattened complex field entry excluded from optimization
D.success: optimizer success and dimensionless translation error <= max(0.005,5*noise); also report amplitude errors independently
D.derivative: normalized k*length coordinates; central difference audit step 1e-5 and 5e-6, error <= 1e-7
D.timing: cold response+derivative build plus all refreshes and optimizer work; reference generation separately; local pilot then fresh-process paired confirmation

publication: no release; preserve old manuscripts and failed runs; v3 Markdown research revision; do not infer NCS acceptance from passing audits
